title: Strategy budgets
description: How much capital each strategy may hold. Intent only — changing a number moves nothing. Allocation shifts as fills free or commit capital, so a growing strategy can only deploy what a shrinking one has sold. Zero means wind down.

TRANSFER_TO.title: Hand freed capital to
TRANSFER_TO.description: Strategy id that receives capital as an over-budget strategy sells. Empty means freed capital returns to unallocated rather than to any strategy.

MANUAL-001.title: MANUAL — discretionary clicks
MANUAL-001.description: Discretionary trades. MANUAL is always live and ungated, so this measures the sleeve rather than limiting it.

MOMENTUM-002.title: MOMENTUM — daily systematic rotation
MOMENTUM-002.description: Daily candidate-pool rotation. Sizing is per position, so this bounds the sleeve, not the position count.

BCTROT-004.title: BCTROT — BCT rotation, midday and close
BCTROT-004.description: Same pool and rules as MOMENTUM, decided at midday and near the close instead of after the open. Runs alongside it and takes over gradually as MOMENTUM sheds positions.

QC345-003.title: QC345 — monthly top-down rotation
QC345-003.description: Monthly rotation. Capital granted here stays idle until the next rebalance day and until it covers a whole position. Needs 254 sessions of history before deciding anything.

QC345_UNIVERSE.title: QC345 ranking universe
QC345_UNIVERSE.description: Symbols QC345 ranks across. Empty blocks startup when QC345 is enabled — it ranks cross-sectionally, so an empty universe can never produce a decision.

QC345_ENABLED.title: Register QC345
QC345_ENABLED.description: Register QC345-003 on the node. Registering is not trading — the lifecycle state decides that, and only an operator can set TRADING.

QC345_UNIVERSE_REFRESH.title: Refresh QC345 universe daily
QC345_UNIVERSE_REFRESH.description: Rebuild the ranking universe from Alpaca once a day and write it below. Takes about six minutes in the background. Off means the list stays exactly as typed.

MOMENTUM-002_SLOTS.title: MOMENTUM — decision times
MOMENTUM-002_SLOTS.description: When this strategy decides, relative to the US session — e.g. `open+5m`, `close-20m`. Built-in: `open+5m`. Empty uses the built-in. Applies on the next engine restart; no rebuild needed.

MOMENTUM_N_HOLD.title: MOMENTUM — names held (override)
MOMENTUM_N_HOLD.description: Names MOMENTUM-002 holds at once. Absent = the researched value in strategies/momentum.py (no schema default; the code is the source). Steers MOMENTUM-002 only (#794).

MOMENTUM_BUFFER.title: MOMENTUM — ranking buffer (override)
MOMENTUM_BUFFER.description: Ranks a held name may slip below the hold rank before it is sold. Absent = the researched value in strategies/momentum.py. Steers MOMENTUM-002 only (#794).

MOMENTUM_GIVE_BACK_FRAC.title: MOMENTUM — give-back exit fraction (override)
MOMENTUM_GIVE_BACK_FRAC.description: Exit once a position has surrendered this fraction of its peak gain (0.35 = 35%; 1 = exit only at flat). 0 is refused: the lane reads 0 as OFF. Absent = the researched value in strategies/momentum.py. Steers MOMENTUM-002 only (#794); ks#221's knob (#1054).

MOMENTUM_TAKE_PROFIT_ATR.title: MOMENTUM — take-profit target (× ATR, override)
MOMENTUM_TAKE_PROFIT_ATR.description: Sell in strength once a position is this many ATR above entry (4.5 = ks#221). Absent = OFF, today's behaviour; no researched value. Floor 3.0: the lab's grid never went below 3.25 and < 3 ATR costs ~9pp. Steers MOMENTUM-002 only (#794); #1055.

BCTROT-004_SLOTS.title: BCTROT — decision times
BCTROT-004_SLOTS.description: When this strategy decides, relative to the US session — e.g. `open+5m`, `close-20m`. Built-in: `open+150m`, `close-20m`. Empty uses the built-in. Applies on the next engine restart; no rebuild needed.

BCTROT_N_HOLD.title: BCTROT — names held (override)
BCTROT_N_HOLD.description: Names BCTROT-004 holds at once. Absent = the researched value in strategies/momentum.py (no schema default; the code is the source). Steers BCTROT-004 only (#794).

BCTROT_BUFFER.title: BCTROT — ranking buffer (override)
BCTROT_BUFFER.description: Ranks a held name may slip below the hold rank before it is sold. Absent = the researched value in strategies/momentum.py. Steers BCTROT-004 only (#794).

BCTROT_GIVE_BACK_FRAC.title: BCTROT — give-back exit fraction (override)
BCTROT_GIVE_BACK_FRAC.description: Exit once a position has surrendered this fraction of its peak gain (0.35 = 35%; 1 = exit only at flat). 0 is refused: the lane reads 0 as OFF. Absent = the researched value in strategies/momentum.py. Steers BCTROT-004 only (#794); ks#221's knob (#1054).

BCTROT_TAKE_PROFIT_ATR.title: BCTROT — take-profit target (× ATR, override)
BCTROT_TAKE_PROFIT_ATR.description: Sell in strength once a position is this many ATR above entry. NOT measured to help BCTROT alone (the lab: -1.3pp at 3.25 by itself) — set only with BCTROT_GIVE_BACK_FRAC 0.35, after MOMENTUM's read-back. Absent = OFF. Floor 3.0. #1055.

QC345-003_SLOTS.title: QC345 — decision times
QC345-003_SLOTS.description: When this strategy decides, relative to the US session — e.g. `open+5m`, `close-20m`. Built-in: `open+5m` (one slot only). Empty uses the built-in. Applies on the next engine restart; no rebuild needed.

TECHIVOL-005.description: TECHIVOL-005 (QC27) budget allocation in USD. Research sized the book at 20000.
TECHIVOL-005.title: Tech IVol — budget

TECHIVOL-005_SLOTS.description: When this strategy decides, relative to the US session. Built-in: `open+150m` (midday, one slot only) — chosen because the median charged spread falls 11.09 to 3.80 bps/leg versus the open. Empty uses the built-in. Applies on the next engine restart.
TECHIVOL-005_SLOTS.title: Tech IVol — decision times

QC27_ENABLED.description: Register TECHIVOL-005 in the node. An absent lifecycle row means TRADING, so this flag is the last gate, not the first of two.

QC27_UNIVERSE.description: Tech candidate pool for TECHIVOL-005. Defaulted, not empty: QC27 cannot derive sector membership live. The strategy still applies its own liquidity and momentum filters, so this is the candidate pool, not the book.

CRSISHORT-006.title: CRSI short — budget
CRSISHORT-006.description: CRSISHORT-006 budget allocation in USD. Research sized the book at 20 slots of 5%; the sleeve is 100% deployed SHORT when full.

CRSISHORT-006_SLOTS.title: CRSI short — decision times
CRSISHORT-006_SLOTS.description: When this strategy decides, relative to the US session. Built-in: `open+5m` (one slot). Empty uses the built-in. Applies on the next engine restart.

CRSI_ENABLED.description: Register CRSISHORT-006 in the node. Registered is SHADOW-only until issue 131 lands: it journals its intent and submits nothing. Requires an IBKR data feed (split-adjusted bars) and either a shortable provider (#857) or CRSI_BORROW_GATE_OFF.

CRSI_UNIVERSE.title: CRSI short — universe
CRSI_UNIVERSE.description: The candidate names the lane subscribes and screens (prev-day dollar volume, price, 100-session vol, ConnorsRSI are applied INSIDE the strategy). Refreshed by a job, not typed by hand; the lane also subscribes what it still holds.

CRSI_MIN_WARM_SYMBOLS.title: CRSI short — minimum warm names
CRSI_MIN_WARM_SYMBOLS.description: How many universe names must carry a full 102-session history before the lane may decide. Signalling on twenty warm names out of hundreds is a different, narrower strategy than the one measured.

CRSI_ACCEPT_EXTENDED_DAILY_BARS.description: Let CRSISHORT-006 run on a feed whose DAILY bars fold pre/post-market in (IBKR declares `extended`). The strategy was measured on regular-hours daily bars; this is a STATED deviation, logged at every boot. Default false: the builder refuses.

CRSI_BORROW_GATE_OFF.description: Turn the locate-fee ceiling OFF for CRSISHORT-006 because this node has no shortable data. A MEASURED change: #123's acceptance run set no fee gate. Record it in the instance RUNBOOK. Ignored when a shortable provider (#857) is present.

MARKET_AWARE_DWELL_POLLS.title: Market-aware — emergency dwell (polls)
MARKET_AWARE_DWELL_POLLS.description: Consecutive polls on which emergency_exit must answer yes before EMERGENCY is reported (phase 1 reports only; nothing acts). An unknown or raising poll breaks the streak. Applies on the next engine restart.

MARKET_AWARE_POLL_SECS.title: Market-aware — poll cadence (seconds)
MARKET_AWARE_POLL_SECS.description: How often the engine asks each registered lane's entries_blocked, emergency_exit and self_assessment hooks. Applies on the next engine restart.

SMHGLD_ENABLED.title: SMHGLD — register
SMHGLD_ENABLED.description: Register SMHGLD-007 in the node (issue 177, platform issue 965). Off by default, no environment gate. Registers SHADOW; an operator moves it to TRADING. Requires kumo-trading-strategies >= 06f3055.

SMHGLD_SYMBOLS.title: SMHGLD — legs
SMHGLD_SYMBOLS.description: The two legs, risk asset then defensive asset. Must equal the upstream config's risk_asset/defensive_asset; the builder refuses anything else by name.

SMHGLD-007.title: SMHGLD — budget
SMHGLD-007.description: SMHGLD-007 budget in USD. Zero reads UNFUNDED and refuses buys. Whole shares put a floor on a usable sleeve (~226k at a 0.25pp band, SMH ~565; issue 186) — set by the coordinator after that answer.

SMHGLD-007_SLOTS.title: SMHGLD — decision times
SMHGLD-007_SLOTS.description: When this strategy decides, relative to the US session. Built-in: `close-20m` (one slot; the fill is market-on-close at 16:00). Empty uses the built-in. Applies on the next boot.
